mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hyperuricemia may reduce febuxostat efficacy, and concurrent use increases risk of gout attacks during febuxostat initiation; both drugs can affect renal function and electrolytes.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels, renal function, and electrolytes; consider alternative antihypertensive if hyperuricemia develops; ensure adequate prophylaxis during febuxostat initiation.
